title: paracaryum lithospermifolium subsp. cariense
intro: Paracaryum lithospermifolium subsp. cariense, commonly known as Cariense Lupin, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, contributing to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Cariense Lupin are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and health benefits of Paracaryum lithospermifolium subsp. cariense, but it has shown promise in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties.
